business_purpose: Records third-party credit bureau integration requests, technical response health, and raw algorithmic risk classifications.
business_question_supported: Did the third-party credit pull complete successfully, and what was the retrieved score/risk status?
grain: One record per unique automated bureau check event (credit_pull_event_id).
dataset_type: System event and logging transaction dataset.
storage_and_ingestion: Streaming architecture using event brokers to parse and store external service calls into an analytical datastore instantly.
ai_consumption: Leveraged as critical historical context to capture financial trend lines and flag technical failure alerts.
ai_assumption: Assumes the external credit bureau API returned a complete profile within normal timeout windows.

columns.business_meaning: A unique, trackable instance of a lender requesting and retrieving a consumer's credit profile from a credit bureau.
Identifies which specific applicant the third-party credit check was initiated for.
The official point-in-time bureau risk rating snapshot used for automated eligibility checks.
Debt-to-Income ratio calculated using verified bureau-reported monthly obligations divided by stated income.
The operational risk tier (e.g., LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH) translated from the base score ranges.
